source_refs.note: Exercise 4.1, Question 6: RC circuit, charging recalled, discharging deduced; book p. 128, answers p. 303 (PDF 305, printed as item 7)

blocks.prompt: 6 For an RC circuit, recall the differential equation representing the charging of a capacitor. Deduce the differential equation that represents the discharging of the capacitor.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ke do hisse hain: pehle Example 4(i) ki charging wali equation yaad karni hai, phir us se discharging ki equation nikalni hai.
Discharging (khaali hona) ka matlab: capacitor pehle se charged hai, battery hata di gayi hai, aur woh resistor ke zariye khaali ho raha hai.
Yani loop mein koi source nahi, \(V_{S} = 0\).
Plan: charging equation likhenge aur us mein \(V_{S} = 0\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: RC circuit; Example 4(i) ki charging equation.
Maloom karna: discharging ki equation.
Tareeqa: charging equation yaad kar ke \(V_{S} = 0\) rakhna.

Charging equation yaad kijiye
\[R\dfrac{dq}{dt} + \dfrac{q}{C} = V_{S}\]
ya
\[RC\dfrac{dq}{dt} = CV_{S} - q\]
Kyun: Kirchhoff's voltage law \(V_{R} + V_{C} = V_{S}\), jahan \(V_{R} = R\frac{dq}{dt}\) (kyunke \(I = \frac{dq}{dt}\)) aur \(V_{C} = \frac{q}{C}\).

Discharging: source nahi
\[RC\dfrac{dq}{dt} = -q\]
\[\dfrac{dq}{dt} = -\dfrac{1}{RC}q\]
Kyun: battery na ho to loop law \(V_{R} + V_{C} = 0\) ban jata hai; ab capacitor khud current chalata hai, jaise bhari hui tanki ka pani khud pipe se behta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(RC\) se divide karte waqt minus sign na bhooliye; yahi batata hai ke charge ghat raha hai.
Is tarah charging aur discharging ka farq sirf ek term \(CV_{S}\) ka hai: battery ho to woh term maujood, battery na ho to gayab.

Tasdeeq:
\(q = q_{0}e^{-t/RC}\) is equation ko poora karta hai (sympy): charge \(q_{0}\) se zero ki taraf girta hai, jaise khaali hote capacitor mein hona chahiye. Key ka jawab \(\frac{dq}{dt} = -\frac{1}{RC}q\) (item 7 par chhapa) milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key is jawab ko number 7 deti hai, 6 nahi. Us ka item 6, \(\frac{dx}{dt} = -\frac{k}{\pi r^{2}}\sqrt{x},\ k > 0\), Exercise 4.1 ke kisi sawal se nahi milta, is liye Questions 6 aur 7 ke jawab items 7 aur 8 par chhape hain. Jawab khud, \(\frac{dq}{dt} = -\frac{1}{RC}q\), sahi hai.
